## History

After working in [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) for a winter, Jordan fell in love with Hester Murray and brought her to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as his wife. He received a farm from his father, built a house on it, and planted a garden that Hester cherished during their four years living together. Following Hester's death, Jordan sold the farm and returned to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston).

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P54](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0054)_
